latin: Siquis in opere precedentis conclusionis intellectualiter operabitur, per meridiem ligabit septentrionem; si uero mundialiter per totum operabitur, iudicium sibi operabitur.
translation: If anyone works intellectually in the operation of the preceding conclusion, he will bind the north through the south; but if he works throughout in a worldly manner, he will work judgment upon himself.
